risk_note: RV2 by path (catalog infra; money review). D10-664 S-09 S09b, D10-736: getProduct's card carries coupon_end_at / sales_text / shop_logo / shop_scores / shop_entry (CT-26s). Switches detail.coupon_end / detail.sales / detail.shop_scores .enabled.<platform> are read per the product's own platform through config.configValue and count as on only when strictly true; off gives null / null / [] (shop_logo unswitched, as given or null). shop_entry is false until S-17 (no shop conversion capability; D10-736 ② criteria documented, TODO blocked on S-17). Union data is cached regardless of switches (D10-736 ⑦): product-cache stores coupon_end_at, sales_text, shop_logo, shop_scores and shop_ref (present as given, absent not written, wrong types unreadable → refetch), and a cache hit or stale answer goes through the same switch path. Favourites cards carry none of the five keys; the pool fallback gives null / null / null / [] / false; other cards unchanged. No amount, no migration, no contract change.

reviews.note: Codex via tools/agent/codex-run.sh, round 1 pass, no findings: detail fields, switches, cache, pool fallback and favourites paths against BR-PRICE-04 / BR-PRICE-21 / BR-TEXT-13 and the contract. Static only. RV2 by path, so a money review.

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
